preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The length of the binary string is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.
The number of '1's in the binary string is between 0 and the length of the string, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: The output contains exactly t integers, one for each test case.
postconditions.description: Each output integer is the maximum value of f(s) over all binary strings s of length n with exactly m '1's.
